title: Resume and checkpoint across hybrid CPU+GPU path
description:
## Goal

Drain semantics for in-flight GPU batches at SIGINT or
heartbeat-checkpoint boundary; resume from checkpoint produces
byte-identical deterministic columns vs an uninterrupted run.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor for
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] SIGINT during hybrid execution drains in-flight GPU
  batches before flushing checkpoint; resume from that checkpoint
  on the same or different host produces byte-identical
  `fer` / `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` vs a reference
  uninterrupted run at the same seed.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
